name: chainpe-wallet
display_name: ChainPe — Algorand Wallet for AI Agents
description: Algorand wallet for Claude. Discover ChainPe services on-chain and pay for them with x402 — no API keys, no accounts.
long_description:
Give Claude an Algorand wallet wired into the ChainPe marketplace. ChainPe adds tools for:

- **search_bazaar** — Discover x402-gated services from the ChainPe on-chain registry
- **x402_fetch** — Fetch a service URL with automatic x402 payment handling
- **check_balance** — View your USDC balance and wallet address
- **pay** — Sign an x402 payment authorization (USDC on Algorand)
- **transfer_usdc** — Send USDC to any Algorand address
- **transfer_algo** — Send ALGO for gas fees
- **spending_report** — Review what the agent has spent today
- **request_funding** — Generate a Pera Wallet top-up link
- **tinyman_swap** / **create_token** — Optional DeFi helpers

Use your 25-word mnemonic to pay with USDC on Algorand Testnet or Mainnet.

Budget limits protect your funds: set max per call and max per day.

algorand_mnemonic.title: Algorand Mnemonic (25 words)
algorand_mnemonic.description: Your Algorand wallet 25-word seed phrase. Used to sign x402 payments on Algorand Testnet or Mainnet. Stored securely in your OS keychain.

max_per_call.title: Max USDC per Payment
max_per_call.description: Maximum USDC allowed per single payment. Safety limit.

max_per_day.title: Max USDC per Day
max_per_day.description: Maximum total USDC allowed per calendar day.

chainpe_registry_app_id.title: ChainPe Registry App ID
chainpe_registry_app_id.description: Algorand application ID of the ChainPe service registry. Leave as default unless you run your own registry.

tools.name: search_bazaar
tools.description: Discover x402-gated services on the ChainPe on-chain registry. Returns name, price, tags, and endpoint.

tools.name: x402_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a service URL with automatic x402 payment. Handles 402 responses by signing the payment and retrying.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check USDC balance and wallet address on the configured network.

tools.name: pay
tools.description: Sign an x402 USDC payment authorization. Returns the payment header value.

tools.name: spending_report
tools.description: Show how much USDC the agent has spent today and the configured limits.
